\begin{example} \end{example}[Euclidean space]

1. ch3:2.10

Let $M=\mathbb {R}^n$. The covariant derivative is the usual derivative, so the geodesics are straight lines parametrized proportionally to arc length; the exponential is the identity (under the usual identification $T_p\mathbb {R}^n\cong \mathbb {R}^n$). \end{example}
